body.condition: Foldwise, \(\sum_{j=0}^{J_n^h}\sum_{\ell=0}^{J_n^q}\widehat\lambda_{a,j\ell}^{(-k)}=\sum_{j=0}^{J_n^h}\sum_{\ell=0}^{J_n^q}\lambda^0_{a,j\ell}=1\) for each arm, and \(\sum_{a=0}^1\sum_{j=0}^{J_n^h}\sum_{\ell=0}^{J_n^q}(|\widehat\lambda_{a,j\ell}^{(-k)}|+|\lambda^0_{a,j\ell}|)\le L_n\).

novel.justification: Exact affine centering and a controlled coefficient envelope are directly enforceable linear constraints in the finite convex projection program and do not select a preferred bridge.
